contentPattern: 4 rows: image | h2 title linked (5-row instances render as a 1 large + 2x2 mosaic); chips option: one row per chip, one cell: link ; anchors option: one row per jump link, one cell: link to #<heading-id>

options.label: Solid: no-image link tiles on solid brand blue, title + arrow, 6 per row
Chips: outlined pill links in a wrapping row, text only (category/filter shortcuts)
Anchors: in-page jump links (one cell: link to #heading-id) in a centered text row; links to ids missing on the page are hidden
